draft.subject: Following up after the webhook fix
draft.body:
Hi Isla,

Glad Tariq was able to get the webhook payload issue sorted for you — that ticket is closed on our side, so do say if anything still looks off.

With your first project in Wrenfield up and running, the next step that usually makes the biggest difference is getting real work living inside it: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. A teammate can also be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through whatever's next for Orchard Media.

Best,
Priya
